# Dispatch Worker

**Container** · Go · inside [Delivery Platform](delivery-platform.md)

Finds a nearby courier for every order that's ready.

A background worker: nobody calls it. It reacts to events on the queue.

## Uses

| Element | Description | Technology |
|---|---|---|
| [Order Events](order-events.md) | Reads order-ready events from | Kafka |
| [Orders Database](orders-db.md) | Records which courier has each order | SQL |
| [Maps Service](maps-service.md) | Estimates travel times using | HTTPS |
| [Messaging Provider](messaging-provider.md) | Offers jobs to couriers using | HTTPS |
